infoIntro: Create a personal access token at https://www.energy-tracker.best-ios-apps.de and save it. Depending on its permissions, select your devices or enter their IDs.
helpPollInterval: Pause after each completed calculation cycle. Independent of reading submission; may increase with resource count, errors or API cooldowns.
helpReadDevices: Set the extrapolation calendar interval for each device. The polling pause applies to all devices.
helpSendEnabled: Send configured source states on their own schedule. Calculation polling is independent.
helpSendSchedule: Uses the ioBroker host time zone. Existing installations keep their previous schedule. Five-field CRON schedules retain a random delay of up to 59 seconds.
helpTimeZone: Search by location or time zone. Leave empty to use the device time zone.
tokenCheckUnavailable: The check could not be completed. Check API availability and try again after the waiting time.
helpDeviceSelection: Select a device if the token permits reading devices; otherwise enter its ID directly.
tokenCheckFormat: Enter the complete personal access token (JWT); the token’s UUID alone is not sufficient.
helpExtrapolationInterval: Calculates daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly values from the available device history.
helpForecastPeriods_day: Number of days from today. The forecast includes the entire last day.
helpForecastPeriods_week: Number of weeks from today. The forecast includes the entire last calendar week.
helpForecastPeriods_month: Number of months from today. The forecast includes the entire last month.
helpForecastPeriods_quarter: Number of quarters from today. The forecast includes the entire last calendar quarter.
helpForecastPeriods_year: Number of years from today. The forecast includes the entire last calendar year.
